about: What the app has when each task is finished, in build order. One task = one finished thing; its parts are the concrete elements or behaviours it ends up with. The current task is the first one not done or dropped; inside it, the first part not done.

legend.dropped: not doing it; say why in note

tasks.title: Split view component
tasks.result: One resizable-panes component for the editor pane, split widgets and multi-column pages, with stories you can drive from controls (plans/split-view.md).

parts.element: 2 or 3 panes, horizontal or vertical, each with default size, min and max in % or px
Collapse: drag past min or press Enter on the handle; the handle stays to reopen it
Compact: the pane shrinks to a fixed-width rail; its header and lists (e.g. widget cards) show icons only, with tooltips, and the header icon expands it
Close: the pane goes away and focus returns to what opened it
Pane header with Back, title, Collapse and Close
Narrow container: the pane opens as a Drawer instead
Sizes saved on release, double-click resets
Playground story with controls for every option
Stories: editor side pane, chart | table widget (side by side and stacked), three-column planner, narrow drawer
Keyboard story: arrows resize, Enter collapses, Close returns focus

tasks.title: Docked side pane
tasks.where: Dashboard page, right of the grid
tasks.result: Palette, widget editor and Inspect open in a resizable pane beside the grid instead of a drawer over it.

parts.element: Side pane (SplitView) next to the grid; the grid gets narrower when it opens
Add widget palette opens in the pane
Widget editor opens in the pane
Inspect opens in the pane
Close button in the pane header; focus goes into the pane on open and back to the button that opened it on close
PaneDrawer is gone; Drawer only for real overlays

tasks.title: Grouped page control bar

parts.element: Page actions group: create, edit, share, export, save
View controls group: filters, time range, refresh, view
Editor controls group: undo, redo, add widget (edit mode only)
Overflow menu that takes the controls that don't fit; groups stay apart at 667 px

tasks.title: Edit bar

parts.element: "Editing" badge that changes when there are unsaved changes

Redo icon button with tooltip, Ctrl+Shift+Z; disabled when nothing to redo
Add widget as the only filled button, never hidden by screen width
Save button with spinner while saving, plus a menu entry "Save and done"; disabled while clean
Discard as a quiet button; disabled while clean; asks "Discard changes?" (Keep editing / Discard changes)
One icon menu with Import JSON and Export JSON; Export no longer also in the page actions
Done button; with unsaved changes it opens the leave dialog (Save, Keep draft, Discard, Keep editing)
Save stays reachable while scrolling a long dashboard, without covering a tile or the side pane
At 667 px the bar and grid dragging are both on or both off (one editable flag from the grid's width)
